item.title: Design Patterns: Abstract Factory Pattern - Designing for Families of Related Objects
item.description: A practical Java-oriented look at the Abstract Factory pattern, including when it helps, how it differs from a simple factory, and how it keeps object creation flexible without creating a mess of conditionals.

item.title: Design Patterns: Singleton Pattern - When One Instance Is the Right Design

item.title: Design Patterns: Why They Matter and How SOLID Principles Give Them Teeth
